name: Victimize

abilities.text: Choose two target creature cards in your graveyard. Sacrifice a creature. If you do, return the chosen cards to the battlefield tapped.

notes: The two creature cards are a real target requirement (return-from-graveyard with target: true, count 2): legal.ts emits a graveyard-card spec for it at CAST time - targets inside a 'conditional' are asked for with the container's own index (docs/vocabulary/composition.md section 3) - so they are chosen when the spell is cast and re-checked on resolution (CR 601.2c, 608.2b). 'Sacrifice a creature. If you do' is the conditional's gate: the sacrifice is mandatory while you control a creature, and the return happens only in that branch, which is exactly when 'if you do' holds. The previous draft used a reflexive trigger, which chose the cards when the reflexive went on the stack rather than on cast.
